question_text: A 25-year-old previously healthy woman presents to her PCP reporting cessation of menses for the past 6 months. Previously, her period occurred regularly, every 30 days. She also complains of decreased peripheral vision, most noticeably when she is driving her car. She denies any recent sexual activity and a pregnancy test is negative. Upon further work-up, what other physical findings may be discovered?
